Emit a koine fourth-opinion fit

Source: R/emit_koine.R
emit_koine.Rd

Activates the koine lens-axis backend from the companion. Given a flexyBayes fb_terms intermediate representation (the $fb element of any core fit) and the model frame, emit_koine() synthesises koine's fourth opinion and returns a flexybayes_koine object. lens_from_fit() turns it into a lens that agreement_pairwise() and quorum() compare with an engine-axis fit (greta / INLA / brms / gretaR).

Usage

emit_koine(
  fb,
  data,
  n_samples = 4000L,
  seed = 1L,
  the_call = NULL,
  standardise = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

fb

An fb_terms object (the $fb element of a core flexyBayes fit).

data

The model frame the fit was built on.

n_samples

Integer count of opinion draws to synthesise.

seed

Integer RNG seed, pinned for reproducibility regardless of caller RNG state.

the_call

Optional originating call, carried into the fit's extras.

standardise

Logical. koine's random-effects lenses carry a fixed N(0, 5) prior on every coefficient and lognormal(0, 2) priors on the residual and group SDs, which the pass-level prior does not reach. On a response measured in the hundreds that prior dominates the opinion: the intercept is pulled toward zero and the group SD absorbs the offset. With standardise = TRUE (the default) the Gaussian response is centred and scaled and every non-intercept covariate is scaled to unit SD before koine fits, and the draws are mapped back to the original scale afterwards, so the same prior becomes a scale-aware weakly-informative one; the fit declares prior = "koine_scaled" in its extras. With FALSE koine fits the data as given and declares "koine_default".

...

Reserved for future use.

Value

A flexybayes_koine object: a list with status ("contributed" or "abstained"), the canonicalised draws, the koine koine result, the fb IR, and an extras record (stacking weights, stacked ELPD, independence and diagnostics on the contributed path; the refusal reason and detail on the abstained path). On the abstained path the object's class additionally carries "quorum_abstention" and "orchestra_refusal" prepended ahead of "flexybayes_koine", so a producer-agnostic decline predicate (any class ending in _refusal / _abstention, or the orchestra_refusal marker) recognises the outer object without inspecting $koine; inherits(x, "flexybayes_koine") and every *.flexybayes_koine method still dispatch unchanged.

Details

koine's corner is a population GLM for the gaussian, binomial, and poisson families, with either a single random intercept (1 | g) or – from koine 0.3.0 – the breeder-standard multi-environment-trial structure of two crossed or nested random intercepts, (1 | variety) + (1 | trial). A single grouping is routed through koine_pass_from_design(group = ); two groupings are routed through koine_pass_from_design(groups = ), koine's crossed / nested entry, and whether they are crossed or nested is resolved by koine from the data. Outside that corner – more than two groupings, a random slope, a correlated random structure, koine below 0.3.0 on a two-grouping model – or whenever koine's own convergence gate fires, the returned object carries status = "abstained", the typed fourth column. The synthesised opinion is a stacking mixture over koine's battery, an independent witness on the orthogonal lens axis, never a pool across the engine-axis backends.

Activation is gated by koine_status(): koine installed at or above 0.2.0 and options(quorum.koine_activated = TRUE) (the default). The draws are canonicalised to flexyBayes's parameter tokens, so the fit is self-naming and needs no name_map when it is compared: the group SDs koine reports as tau / tau_<grouping> become sd_<grouping>.

See also

koine_status() for the activation state; lens_from_fit() and agreement_pairwise() for comparing the result with another fit.
